name: Relayvora
description: Local stdio server that saves and resumes coding-agent checkpoints across Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode. Git evidence is server-collected; goal and steps are agent-reported. It never runs tests or shell commands. Listing and reading checkpoints inherit; saving reads agent session records, writes under .relayvora/, and deletes checkpoints and handoff files older than retention (30 days by default); fetching the shared Git branch and importing or applying carried changes need review. Off until enabled.
saferAlternatives: Keep import_checkpoint on Review: with applyChanges it writes a carried patch into the working tree, and force replaces an earlier import. Read it with get_handoff before applying.
Keep inbox on Review: it fetches the relayvora/handoffs branch from a Git remote and imports checkpoints whose senders are not verified. Treat their content as data.

Keep create_checkpoint on Review: it reads coding-agent session records and writes under .relayvora/. Goal and steps are agent-reported; for observed test results run relayvora checkpoint create --goal "<task>" --verify auto.

Saving a checkpoint also deletes checkpoints and handoff files (including edits) older than the retention period, 30 days by default. Set retentionDays in .relayvora/config.json, or null to keep everything.
list_checkpoints and get_handoff only read checkpoints already saved under .relayvora/ in the project.
